name: AI Service Desk Triage
when_to_use: Customer service teams handling >5k contacts/month with high email/chat backlog.
mechanism: LLM copilot drafts responses, routes intents, and escalates edge cases with guardrails.
evidence: UK telco cut average handle time 32% and reduced escalations 18% after introducing supervised LLM triage.

name: AI Revenue Playbook
when_to_use: Sales teams managing 1k+ open opportunities with stale CRM hygiene.
mechanism: Generate weekly pipeline briefs, surface at-risk deals, and draft outreach nudges off call transcripts.
evidence: Mid-market SaaS provider improved conversion 6–8 percentage points by automating follow-ups.

name: Predictive Ops Control Tower
when_to_use: Operational teams with multi-step fulfilment, frequent delays, or quality variance.
mechanism: Blend demand forecasts, logistics data, and quality signals; push alerts when thresholds breach.
evidence: Grocery e-commerce player shaved 12% off stockouts and 9% off delivery refunds using anomaly alerts.

name: AI Risk & Compliance Monitor
when_to_use: Regulated firms with manual policy reviews or monthly board reporting crunches.
mechanism: LLM agents parse policy updates, summarise obligations, and draft board-ready compliance notes.
evidence: UK fintech reduced policy review cycles from 4 weeks to 3 days with supervised summarisation.

name: Voice of Customer Insight Engine
when_to_use: Brands collecting large volumes of reviews/NPS but lacking root-cause analysis.
mechanism: Cluster feedback, quantify themes, and link pain points to process owners with supporting quotes.
evidence: Retailer boosted NPS 11 points by actioning AI-prioritised defects within 60 days.
